name: System Architecture
description: Generate D2 diagrams for system-level architecture and interactions
helpContent: Create D2 diagrams for visualizing system architecture, component relationships, and data flows.
template:
Create a D2 architecture diagram showing:
1. Major Components/Services
2. Interactions and relationships
3. Data flows
4. External integrations

Use clear labels and organize components logically.

name: Data Flow Diagram
description: D2 diagram showing how data flows through the system
helpContent: Design data flow diagrams in D2 showing how information moves between system components.
template:
Generate a D2 data flow diagram showing:
1. Data sources (users, external APIs, databases)
2. Processing steps
3. Data transformations
4. Storage/caching points
5. Final destinations

Clearly label all flows and transformations.
